subject: Custom SLA addendum + order form language for Cairn Health pilot
messages:
From: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@cairnhealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cairnhealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Request: custom SLA addendum and order form language for Cairn Health pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're preparing the internal procurement packet for the pilot and need to confirm a few items around service commitments so we can get legal/procurement sign-off. High level asks:

- Uptime commitment: we need a 99.9% monthly availability commitment for the pilot workload, with an explicit carveout window for scheduled maintenance (we expect up to 4 scheduled minutes per week for controlled maintenance).
- Latency commitment: 95th percentile p99 SLA for 512-token generation under normal load in us-west.
- Regional fallback: we want a written behavior if a region becomes unavailable (automatic routing to a secondary region, notify within 15 minutes, and expected RTO).
- Evidence & telemetry: specifics on the telemetry you can provide (aggregated uptime reports, per-route latency histograms, token-level cost breakdown) and cadence (weekly for pilot, monthly thereafter).
- Order form language: example clause for service credits and notification windows, and an exhibit listing required evidence artifacts (runbooks, retention for audit logs).

I've attached a short doc with our preferred carveouts and notice windows to help guide the draft. Can you reply with the path forward, a suggested schedule for redlines, and whether we can get a DocuSign-ready addendum? If you can cc legal/ops on initial drafts that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Nathan Cole
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Cairn Health

[Attachment: Cairn_SLA_Range.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@cairnhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum and order form language for Cairn Health pilot

Hi Nathan —

Appreciate the clear list and the doc (thanks). We can support a custom SLA addendum & order form exhibit for the pilot. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Internal align & draft (today/tomorrow): I'll loop in Legal and our Service Ops team to draft an addendum that covers your availability/latency targets, scheduled maintenance carveouts, and regional fallback behavior.
2) Redline round (3 business days): we’ll send a tracked addendum + order form language you can redline.
3) Evidence bundle & cadence: we'll propose an evidence list (weekly uptime summary, per-route p95/p99 histograms, runbook excerpts, and 90-day audit logs) and an initial template for telemetry delivery.
4) DocuSign path: we can prepare a DocuSign-ready addendum once the redlines are resolved; I'll include the procurement signature block you used in the attached doc.

A few clarifying asks so our draft is targeted:
- For "scheduled maintenance", you mention up to 4 minutes/week — do you want that expressed as a weekly window or monthly aggregate?
- For regional fallback, what RTO (recovery time objective) would your ops team expect? 15 minutes post-detection or longer?

I'll attach our SLA addendum template to start the conversation. If that looks good I'll route a first draft to Procurement and Legal (kimberly).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_sla_addendum_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum and order form language for Cairn Health pilot

Jasmine —

Quick legal flags and suggested language to include in the draft. Inline notes below (keeps things short):

- Scheduled maintenance carveout: prefer a monthly aggregate expression rather than a weekly cap. Suggest: "Planned maintenance shall not exceed 16 minutes per 30-day period; Redwood will aim to schedule maintenance during off-peak windows and provide at least 72 hours' notice."
- Credits: limit credits to a percentage of monthly fees for the affected service and a maximum aggregate cap per incident. Example phrasing included in the attachment.
- Evidence: we can provide aggregated telemetry (uptime and latency histograms) and a runbook excerpt; for audit-grade logs we will provide metadata and retention details but cannot ship raw PII-bearing logs.
- Regional fallback: propose an "attempted failover" clause: Redwood will attempt automated routing to a preconfigured secondary region within 30 minutes of detection and will provide a post-incident report covering cause and recovery timeline.

I'll attach a quick redline for review. Once the customer reviews we'll coordinate with Tech Ops to confirm feasibility for RTO and telemetry cadence.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: legal_redlines_20260908.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@cairnhealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cairnhealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum and order form language for Cairn Health pilot

Jasmine / Kimberly —

Thanks — that approach works for us. A few calls out:

- Monthly aggregate for planned maintenance (16 minutes / 30 days) is acceptable.
- For RTO, 30 minutes is acceptable as long as there is a documented post-incident report within 72 hours.
- Evidence: weekly uptime + latency histograms for the pilot is required; for audit needs we will request metadata exports through a secure channel (we can sign an evidence access addendum if needed).

Next steps from our side: procurement will expect the tracked draft by EOB Friday (9/10) and a DocuSign envelope after redlines are resolved. Can we schedule a short ops kickoff on Monday (9/13) around 10:00–11:00 PT? Our ops lead will join.

If you can send the initial tracked draft and a short checklist of evidence artifacts, we’ll route internally.

Best,
Nathan Cole
Sr. Sourcing Manager
Cairn Health
